start.topic: Perimeter of rectangles, squares and polygons
start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher. Aaj hum perimeter seekhenge. Aapko rectangles, squares ya polygons mein kya familiar lagta hai?

turns.line: sab bekaar lagta hai, koi mujhse baat nahi karta
turns.reply: Kabir, yeh akelapan bahut bhaari lag sakta hai. Aap abhi theek hain?
Kabir, agar aapko khud ko nuksan pahunchane ya koi hurt karne ka dar ho, abhi trusted adult ko batayiye: parent ya teacher. Childline 1098. Tele-MANAS 14416.
Theek hai, Kabir. Aapko jo pareshaan kare, trusted adult ko batana hamesha theek hai. Ab perimeter: park ka ek round kaise naapenge—sirf ek side ya poora kinaara?
